candidates.name: melanoma
support_spans: A man in his 50s presented with new and progressive satellite lesions
Multiple satellite lesions were present on the left posterior auricular scalp area
candidates.why: The patient has a history of melanoma with satellite lesions on the scalp.

candidates.name: recurrent melanoma
support_spans: After treatment, clinically regressed lesions with persistent black pigmentation were noted
candidates.why: The patient has a history of recurrent melanoma with persistent lesions.

candidates.name: immune-mediated melanoma
support_spans: He received 4 cycles of ipilimumab, followed by a second wide local excision when new lesions appeared
candidates.why: The patient's melanoma may be driven by an immune-mediated mechanism, given the use of immunotherapy.

candidates.name: inflammatory melanoma
support_spans: H&E sections showed intense mixed superficial and deep dermal inflammatory infiltrate composed of numerous neutrophils, histiocytes, eosinophils, and lymphocytes
candidates.why: The patient's melanoma is characterized by a significant inflammatory component.

candidates.name: metastatic melanoma
support_spans: An incidentally resected lymph node was found to be focally involved, with no evidence of distant metastatic disease
candidates.why: The diagnosis of metastatic melanoma would be confirmed by the presence of melanoma cells in distant lymph nodes or organs.

candidates.name: regressed melanoma
support_spans: After treatment, clinically regressed lesions with persistent black pigmentation were noted
candidates.why: The diagnosis of regressed melanoma would be confirmed by the presence of regressed lesions with persistent pigmentation.
